title: Orbit–Wave–OES Lab: synthetic orbit, wave-payload, telemetry replay, and binaural capture analysis
description:
Orbit–Wave–OES Lab is a software-only research prototype: a stylized orbital timeline, a classical signed-amplitude sine payload encoding, fixed-threshold synthetic readout, optional OES-Resilience replay scoring, a static SHA-256 evidence passport, and offline analysis of a user-provided stereo PCM WAV.

Evidence. Orbit, payload, telemetry events and the bundled demo are SYNTHETIC. Physical orbit propagation, spacecraft hardware, quantum devices, NV-center physics, audio hardware and acoustic calibration are UNRUN.

Limits. Classical software arithmetic only. No QKD, quantum advantage, real satellite hardware, flight-readiness, clinical, security or SMAP/MSL beat claim. Upstream OES-Resilience reports that its own preregistered criteria were not met. Collaborators credited in the README are not creators of this software and have not confirmed authorship or endorsement of results.
notes: Collaborators Mun Seok Lee and Somnath Laha (CSIR-CMERI) are credited for related conceptual work; they are listed as contributors of type Other, not creators.
